title: Variance bounded by the mean squared difference
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, s ⊆ ℝⁿ (ℝⁿ = Euclid n) with Lⁿ(s) < ∞, and f : ℝⁿ → ℝ square-integrable on s (MemLp f 2 (Lⁿ restricted to s)). Let ω := Lⁿ(s) as a real number and f̄ := (∫_s f)/ω. Then ∫_s (f − f̄)² ≤ ω^{−1}·∫_s∫_s (f(x) − f(y))² dy dx. When ω = 0 both sides are 0, with Lean's conventions 0^{−1} = 0 and a/0 = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (s : Set (Euclid n)) (f : Euclid n → ℝ), volume s ≠ ∞ → MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict s) → ∫ x in s, (f x - (∫ y in s, f y) / (volume s).toReal) ^ 2 ≤ ((volume s).toReal)⁻¹ * ∫ x in s, ∫ y in s, (f x - f y) ^ 2
